text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's training in preparation
for the
Mainichi Hai has been coming
along smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... How's my time?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Great!
choice_data_list_en: You've closed the gap since yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: もう1本、次はラップを意識して
choice_data_list_en: One more run. Focus on your lap times this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki turns around and
suddenly stops in
her tracks. I follow the
direction of her gaze to
see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... My legs feel as heavy as bricks... I
gotta
build more muscle strength...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to work out more. So for going
uphill...
Ah, maybe my abs and back
muscles are too
weak...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I move laterally too, will my
momentum will add
to my speed?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll try going uphill again, but
diagonally
this time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She was so disappointed after
performing
poorly recently. She must be
trying to rectify the
issues she had.
choice_data_list: 彼女、気合い入ってるな
彼女、気合い入ってるね
choice_data_list_en: She's really fired up, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's reflected on her race,
determined
what needs to be improved
on, and applied those
changes in
training...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And now she's analyzing each lap she
ran during
practice to discern further
flaws that require
improvement...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To be able to take this analysis and set
new goals
instead of aimlessly running
an endless number of
laps...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Her ability to face her own weaknesses
so boldly
and improving upon them is
remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What exceptional mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In martial arts, we also believe that
diligent effort
will ultimately give rise to
great growth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She is not to be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I knew it'd be difficult to grasp
the timing
for the last spurt just by doing
mental
visualizations...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiya, Chiyo! ♪ Why the scrunchy face?

Something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maruzen! Ah, uh... No, I'm doing just
fine!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See, this is why I can never let you be.
You remind
me of myself in that respect.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, you're looking for someone to
run with,
right? I can help you out with
that! But be
warned—I'm a real speed
demon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How could you tell?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you were right on my tail at the
race the
other day, but you just couldn't
quite overtake
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Since it's you we're talking about, I
figured you'd
probably be out here
trying to figure out a way to
overcome
that roadblock!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, you're spot on! But... are you
sure
you're okay running with me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Totally! You've accepted the dream I
entrusted to
you and are always working
so hard to achieve
it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course I want to help out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow, thanks a million!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Sakura Chiyono O and
Maruzensky,
also known as the Hot Rod,
are going to run
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky possesses a wealth of
experience
with the Twinkle Series, so
there's much that can
be learned from
running with her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen has a talent for looking after
others. No
doubt running with her will
help open Chiyono O's
eyes to her own
weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And that will surely lead to her
overcoming them
and becoming even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be sitting around! I'm
going for
another run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After she's done at the track, we move
to the gym
and come across another
familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew... This is my limit, it seems...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right, Ardan? You don't look
too well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yaeno. There's no need to worry
about me.
I'm perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is simply how I stop to catch my
breath
whenever things feel a bit
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If you say so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural that Yaeno Muteki is
concerned.
Mejiro Ardan has been
hospitalized a good
number of times
because of her frail constitution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear that's why her debut has been
perpetually
delayed, though she's long
since entered the
state of rapid growth
known as being race-ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's always the risk that she'll be
hospitalized
again if she were to put
excessive strain on her
body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to train every little bit that I can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If I were to idle the days away, I'd be
unable to
catch up to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You did say you'd make your debut this
year no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So I did. Given how much time I've
already wasted
since becoming
race-ready...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The amount of time I have left as a
competitive
racer is increasingly meager
compared to other
runners.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wish to use everything at my
disposal
in order to successfully debut
this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I would rather shine on the turf for just a
moment,
no matter how brief it may be,
than fade into
obscurity without having
accomplished anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Everything I choose to do is done with
careful
consideration, so please don't
worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made such a resolute
declaration, Mejiro
Ardan leaves to
resume her training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What admirable determination!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She's intent on running, even if it means
risking
her life.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I'm just as resolved as she is!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must perfect control of the blaze fierce
and
water still, and carve my victory in
stone!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's rivals have ignited a fire
inside
her, and the steady flames of that
blaze can be
clearly seen in her eyes.
